git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Route global paths through sys::bivvy_data_dir()

All subsystems (state, snapshots, logs, registry, telemetry,
trust, config) were hardcoding ~/.bivvy as the global data
directory. This bypassed the existing sys::data_dir() platform
abstraction, putting everything under $HOME on every OS.

Add sys::bivvy_data_dir() which returns data_dir()/bivvy and
migrate every call site. Paths now resolve to the correct
platform convention:

  macOS:   ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy/
  Linux:   $XDG_DATA_HOME/bivvy/ (or ~/.local/share/bivvy/)
  Windows: %APPDATA%/bivvy/

Project-local .bivvy/ directories (config, templates, workflows)
are unchanged — they live in the project root by design.
EOF
)"
